text_block_list.text:
After overcoming fierce rivals to win the 
Osaka Hai, Daiwa Scarlet is challenged to 
a rematch by Vodka, who has temporarily 
returned home.

The decisive stage is the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). Wagering the highest honor for 
Senior-class Umamusume, the two would 
compete against each other.
